entries.113648719260f571: FUJI LATEX CO., LTD. is headquartered in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, and conducts its business with two consolidated subsidiaries. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 is 253. It was established in 1949 as Nihon Latex Kōgyosho Co., Ltd. and changed its name to its current name in 1961.

entries.19c9647fb4c3127a: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥63 million. The prior year was ¥298 million. The main factor behind the decline was the recording of one-time costs associated with the relocation and consolidation of the Tochigi Plant.
entries.1a40d5899f87b93e: Under the Fifth New Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal years ended March 2024 through March 2026), the company pursued accelerated growth centered on 'Strengthening of Monozukuri' and, in the process, suspended condom manufacturing and consolidated aging plants. Over the medium to long term, the company will build on three pillars: strengthening existing businesses, strengthening 'Monozukuri,' and becoming a one-and-only presence in each business field to form a group of highly profitable businesses. It will aim to strengthen its sales base, centered on developing new markets, and to improve profitability and strengthen its financial structure. In the Precision Equipment Business, the company aims to become a global niche company as a comprehensive buffer manufacturer, and plans to establish a two-major-plant structure in the fiscal year ending March 2027 through plant consolidation.
entries.1a8adc9f5b3f6385: This business manufactures and sells food containers and other products. entries.74710790cebb0879: The company has core technology based on world-leading thin-film rubber technology and new materials, and makes rubber products by drawing on its proprietary technical capabilities and know-how. In the Precision Equipment Business, its strength lies in its technical capability to produce proprietary products that are high-level, unique and cost-effective. In the Food Container Business, the company holds the position of Japan's largest manufacturer of rubber food containers.
entries.750e0b185496c323: This business manufactures and sells medical devices, including rubber products and probe covers. The consolidated subsidiary Fuji Life Co., Ltd. mainly sells the company's products, such as condoms. Condom production at the aging Tochigi Plant was stopped, and the relocation and consolidation to the Tochigi Chizuka Plant was completed in June 2025. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,127 million. PIP Co., Ltd. is listed as a major customer.

entries.8eab89d2e5c6323f: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,798 million, a decrease of 5.6% from the prior year. By business, the Precision Equipment Business was ¥4,401 million, the Medical Equipment Business ¥2,127 million, the Food Container Business ¥182 million and the SP Business ¥86 million. Although the Precision Equipment Business grew sales well in both domestic and overseas markets, the decline in revenue from the suspension of condom manufacturing and the drop in sales from the restructuring of the SP Business weighed on results.
